title: Lemon Butter Parslied Potatoes
description: Boiled red potatoes, sliced and browned in butter with lemon peel and juice, parsley and a last-minute hit of garlic.

steps.heading: Boil
steps.text: Put the potatoes in a 1½- to 2-quart saucepan with enough salted water to cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Boil uncovered 8 to 10 minutes, until tender; drain.

steps.heading: Slice
steps.text: When cool enough to handle, cut the potatoes into scant ½-inch slices.

steps.heading: Lemon
steps.text: Grate 1 tsp peel from the lemon and squeeze 1 tsp juice.

steps.heading: Brown
steps.text: Melt the butter in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add the lemon peel and juice, 1 tbsp of the parsley, the salt, pepper and potatoes, and cook 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until the potatoes begin to brown.

steps.heading: Finish
steps.text: Add the garlic and cook 1 minute. Sprinkle with the remaining parsley to serve.
